name: Vintage Teen
description: A vintage pocket-sampler face made for reading: a big LCD time and six large readout screens for steps, date, pulse, temperature, battery and weekday, plus one orange button.

steps.script: const n = project.elements.length; ['Hour','Colon','Minute'].forEach((nm,i)=>{ project.elements[n-3+i].name = nm + ' Aod'; }); return 1
